- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence remains thin for most kinds of change; only eight kinds have at least 2 tests.
'home, wait_info' is helpful, supported by three winning tests out of five (+2.7% average after noise correction).
'finish, new_screen' is helpful overall, backed by two winning tests out of four (+2.2% average after noise correction).
No clear effect was seen for 'adoption, notification', 'sign_in, incentive', 'sign_in, hint', and 'adoption, layout', as all tests yielded no clear effect.
Results for 'choose_path, copy' remain inconsistent across tests (one worse, one won), so no clear pattern has been established.
Predictions were often overly optimistic for unhelpful changes, while underpredicting gains on major winning tests.

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Story Scroll Adoption Certificate Review Screen: Redesign the adoption certificate screen using a story scroll layout to present pet traits and adoption details in a narrative format. (why: Adoption is the largest funnel drop-off point at 60.9% conversion and 1017s mean time. A structured story scroll view improves engagement.)
1: [sign_in, redesign] Spotlight Account Sign In Layout: Redesign the sign-in screen into a centered spotlight card layout that focuses attention on fast social and passkey authentication. (why: Sign-in screen conversion is 72.9% with a high mean duration (567s). A clean spotlight layout reduces cognitive friction during authentication.)
2: [home, wait_info] Desktop Environment Loading Status Banner: Display real-time desktop render environment setup status messages on the waiting screen. (why: Home waiting duration is long (median 201s) and 3 users reported pets failing to appear. Providing home wait_info has a proven history of boosting conversion (+2.7%).)
3: [home, wait_info] Pet Generation Activity Stream on Waiting Screen: Add live status updates describing pet creation milestones during the waiting screen. (why: The transition from adoption to waiting has a high mean time (2336s). Adding explicit wait_info improves clarity during long background tasks (+2.7% proven effect).)
4: [choose_path, layout] Split Layout Onboarding Path Selection: Update the path selection screen layout to a two-column split view contrasting instant pet adoption against custom pet creation. (why: Choose path step has a high mean duration (514s) suggesting users struggle to evaluate their options quickly.)
